definition_zh: 犬的；似犬的；犬齿；犬科动物
definition_en: of or like a dog; also a pointed tooth beside the incisors, or a member of the dog family
core_image: 一只狼站直了与人对视：同样的牙列，尖尖的犬齿在最前排
scene: 宠物医院候诊室里，牧羊犬安静地趴在主人脚边。The vet checked the canine teeth and pronounced them perfectly healthy.
sceneCN: 这里 canine 是「犬齿」（第 2 个义项：门牙旁的尖牙）；句意是兽医检查了犬齿，宣布它们非常健康。

derivatives.zh: 由 canine 加抽象后缀构成，义为「犬性；犬的特征」（罕用）
同根学术名词，义为「犬科动物」（生物学分类用语）
同根远亲，义为「金丝雀」（同出拉丁语 canis 词根的岛名）

senses.title: Of or relating to dogs
senses.definition: belonging to or characteristic of dogs and their relatives
senses.definitionCN: 属于狗及其近亲的，或具有其特征的
senses.example: The shelter runs a canine adoption program every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 收容所每年春天举办犬类领养活动。
senses.why: The Latin canis is simply dog, so anything dog-flavored takes the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 canis 就是「狗」，一切带狗味的事物都用这个形容词。

senses.title: A pointed tooth beside the incisors
senses.definition: one of the four pointed teeth in humans and carnivores, used for tearing
senses.definitionCN: 人类与食肉动物口中用于撕咬的四颗尖牙之一
senses.example: Her left canine is slightly longer than the others.
senses.exampleCN: 她的左犬齿比其他牙稍长一点。
senses.why: The tooth is named for the dog, whose fangs are the model of the shape.
senses.whyCN: 这颗牙以狗命名，狗的尖牙正是这一齿形的范本。

senses.title: A member of the dog family
senses.definition: any mammal of the family Canidae, including wolves, foxes, and jackals
senses.definitionCN: 犬科哺乳动物的任一成员，包括狼、狐、豺等
senses.example: Wolves and foxes are both canines.
senses.exampleCN: 狼和狐狸都属于犬科动物。
senses.why: The family name formalizes the dog root into a biological category.
senses.whyCN: 科名把「狗」词根正式化为生物学分类。

senses.title: Doglike in manner
senses.definition: resembling a dog in devotion, eagerness, or other behavior
senses.definitionCN: 在忠诚、热切或其他行为上像狗一样
senses.example: He greeted her with canine devotion, tail-wagging enthusiasm included.
senses.exampleCN: 他以狗一般的忠诚迎接她，连摇尾巴的热乎劲儿都有。
senses.why: The dog's famous loyalty turns the adjective into a portrait of devotion.
senses.whyCN: 狗以忠诚闻名，形容词因此转而描绘忠犬般的姿态。

intro.en: Canine comes straight from Latin caninus, of a dog, built on canis, dog, one of the oldest animal words in the Indo-European family.
intro.cn: canine 直接来自拉丁语 caninus（犬的），建立在 canis（狗）之上，是印欧语系最古老的动物词之一。

items.en: The root *ḱwṓn, dog, survives across the family in Greek kyōn, Latin canis, and English hound.
items.cn: 词根 *ḱwṓn（狗）遍布印欧诸语：希腊语 kyōn、拉丁语 canis、英语 hound。

items.en: Latin canis meant dog; the adjective caninus meant of a dog, later fixed in anatomy for the eye tooth.
items.cn: 拉丁语 canis 意为狗；形容词 caninus 意为犬的，后被解剖学固定用于指尖牙。

items.en: The word reached English in the fourteenth century via French forms, with the tooth sense recorded by the seventeenth.
items.cn: 该词于十四世纪经法语进入英语，犬齿义到十七世纪已有记录。

items.en: Linnaeus fixed Canis as the genus name and Canidae as the family, completing the scientific family.
items.cn: 林奈将 Canis 定为属名、Canidae 定为科名，完善了这套科学词族。

items.en: Modern usage spans pets, police dogs, dentistry, and affectionate metaphor.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖宠物、警犬、牙科以及亲昵的比喻。

note.en: Canine heads the dog-word family and has few true spelling neighbors, but several sound-alikes in -nine and -nine shapes.
note.cn: canine 是「狗」词族之首，真正的拼写近邻不多，但有几个发音相近的词容易混淆。

entries.definition: The songbird, whose island name shares the dog root canis.
entries.definitionCN: 金丝雀，其岛名与 canis 同出「狗」词根。

entries.definition: A doghouse, via French chenil from the same dog word.
entries.definitionCN: 狗窝，经法语 chenil 出自同一「狗」词。

entries.definition: Of or like a cat, the exact cat-side counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 猫的；猫科动物，是与 canine 完全对应的猫方词汇。

entries.definition: Of or like a horse, same -ine pattern from equus.
entries.definitionCN: 马的；马科动物，同一 -ine 模式，源自 equus。

entries.definition: The plain English word for the animal itself.
A hunting dog, the native Germanic descendant of the same ancient root.
entries.definitionCN: 猎犬，同一古老词根的日耳曼本土后裔。

entries.definition: Hungry or fierce like a wolf, figurative kinship within the family.
entries.definitionCN: 狼一般的贪婪凶狠，词族内的比喻近亲。

entries.definition: A long pointed tooth, especially of a dog or snake.
The cat-side counterpart of the same animal-category pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 猫科的，与犬类在分类上形成对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the dog root and the human mouth where the dog tooth lives.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「狗」词根与「人口中的犬齿」的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root core: Latin canis is dog; canine is simply of the dog.
normal.cn: 词根核心：拉丁语 canis 即狗，canine 就是「狗的」。

normal.en: Tooth map: incisors cut, canines tear, molars grind; the canine sits mid-arch.
normal.cn: 牙齿地图：门牙切、犬齿撕、臼齿磨，犬齿在牙弓中段。

normal.en: Family link: Canary Islands, canary, canine, and kennel all grow from one dog word.
normal.cn: 词族关联：加那利群岛、金丝雀、canine、kennel 都从同一个「狗」词长出来。

normal.en: Parallel set: feline for cats, equine for horses, bovine for cattle, canine for dogs.
normal.cn: 平行系列：feline 猫、equine 马、bovine 牛、canine 狗。

normal.en: Professional use: a canine unit means police dogs, standard news vocabulary.
normal.cn: 专业用法：canine unit 指警犬队，是新闻标准用语。

abstract.en: A dog sitting perfectly still, eyes fixed on the door, waiting since morning.
abstract.cn: 一只狗端坐不动，眼睛盯着门，从早晨等到现在。

abstract.en: Your own tongue finding the pointed tooth behind your lip: the wolf you carry.
abstract.cn: 舌尖抵上门牙后的尖牙：那是你随身携带的狼。

abstract.en: A wolf track pressed in snow, shaped exactly like the family pet's paw.
abstract.cn: 雪地上一枚狼的脚印，形状与家犬的爪印一模一样。

examples.en: The canine unit swept the stadium before the concert.
examples.cn: 音乐会开始前，警犬队对体育场进行了搜查。

examples.en: Humans share the four-canine tooth pattern with most carnivores.
examples.cn: 人类与大多数食肉动物共有四颗犬齿的牙型。

examples.en: His canine loyalty made him the office's most trusted assistant.
examples.cn: 他忠犬般的忠诚使他成为办公室里最受信任的助理。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「凯奈」——狗对主人凯旋般迎接、又对陌生人不耐烦地「奈」不得，正是狗脾气；联想人牙列中最尖的那颗犬牙，就像狗的獠牙缩小版。

root: 源自拉丁语 caninus（犬的），词根为 canis（狗），可上溯至印欧词根 *ḱwṓn（狗）。同根词有 canary（金丝雀，经「狗之群岛」）、kennel（狗窝）、hound（猎犬，日耳曼本土同源）。解剖学的「犬齿」因形似狗牙而得名；生物分类的 Canidae（犬科）与 Canis（犬属）亦建在同一词根上。

sensesIntro.en: From the dog itself the word reaches into the human mouth, the biological family tree, and metaphors of loyalty.
sensesIntro.cn: 从狗本身出发，词义伸入人的口腔、生物分类谱系以及关于忠诚的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the dog, oldest of companions, present in anatomy and family tree alike.
core.cn: 核心意象：狗——最古老的伙伴，同时存在于解剖学与生物谱系之中。

branches.en: THE LEASH: everyday adjective for all things dog.
branches.cn: 牵引绳：一切犬事的日常形容词。

branches.en: THE MOUTH: the eye tooth named after the fang.
branches.cn: 口腔：以獠牙命名的尖牙。

branches.en: THE WILD: wolves and foxes folded into one family name.
branches.cn: 荒野：狼与狐同归一个科名。

branches.en: THE HEART: doglike devotion as a human portrait.
branches.cn: 人心：忠犬般的深情作为人的写照。

branches.en: THE PARTNERSHIP: from pet to police dog, the dog beside human work.
branches.cn: 协作：从宠物到警犬，始终伴随人类工作的狗。

intro.en: Canine is the Latin stem can- plus the adjective suffix -ine, one of a matched set of animal adjectives.
intro.cn: canine 由拉丁词干 can- 加形容词后缀 -ine 构成，属于一组成套的动物形容词。

latinIntro.en: The canis root anchors a family from islands to teeth to taxonomy.
latinIntro.cn: canis 词根串起从群岛到牙齿再到分类学的整族词。

items.meaningCN: 具有……性质的形容词后缀

items.example: the canines erupt after the incisors

items.meaningCN: 金丝雀（经「狗之群岛」得名）

latinEntries.exampleCN: 犬齿（拉丁语解剖学用例）。
